entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I... I need to make a return for a VeloBand Cadence Sensor. My order number is VF77819.

Certainly. Let me pull that up for you. VF77819... Yes, I see it here. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered on December 15th, about 28 days ago. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, no, the band is fine. It's... it's just been a very difficult month. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I was so excited, but there was a family emergency right after it arrived.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is alright.

My father had to be rushed to the hospital. He needed emergency surgery, and I've been there with him ever since. My brother couldn't help because his deployment got moved up, so it was all on me. I just completely forgot about everything else, and I feel so terrible, but I really need this money back right now.

I completely understand, and please don't worry about it. Thank you for sharing that with me. Let me just double-check our return policy for you... Okay, I have good news. You're actually well within the return period.
I am? I thought I missed the window.

Not at all. For the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. Since it's only been 28 days, we can absolutely process a full refund for you. No exception is needed.
Oh, wow. Really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you. I was so worried.

Of course. And I see here that you're one of our VIP members. We really appreciate your loyalty, and for everything you've been through, I'd also like to add a $25 credit to your VeloFit account. You can use that on any future purchase.
That is so kind of you. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've been a huge help today.

It's my pleasure. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. Just pack the item in its original box and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can do for you?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I sincerely hope things get better for you and your family.
